Sakigake!! Otokojuku: Nihon yo, Kore ga Otoko de Aru!

Sakigake!! Otokojuku is PS3 game based on manga series written and illustrated by Akira Miyashita. It was originally serialized at the Weekly Shōnen Jump from 1985 to 1991. It is staged in a private boys' school that teaches ōendan to troubled teenagers. The students are trained to "revive the Spirit of Japan" and mainly engage in fighting courses.

Sakigake!! Otokojuku es un juego para PS3 basado en la serie de manga escrita e ilustrada por Akira Miyashita. Se publicó originalmente en la revista Weekly Shōnen Jump entre 1985 y 1991. Transcurre en un internado privado para chicos que enseña ōendan a adolescentes con problemas. Los estudiantes se entrenan para «revivir el espíritu de Japón» y participan principalmente en cursos de lucha.
